findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/Symmetric.lean:33-35 `/-- A matrix `A : Matrix n n α` is "symmetric" if `Aᵀ = A`. -/ ... def IsSymm (A : Matrix n n α) : Prop :=`. The PR's own docstring at line 221-222 uses the word "symmetry".
findings.fix: State it as `ρ.IsTimeReversalInvariant ↔ ρ.mat.IsSymm` and rename to `isTimeReversalInvariant_iff_isSymm` (import `Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Symmetric` if not already transitive).
findings.issue: `isTimeReversalInvariant_iff_transpose_eq` states `ρ.matᵀ = ρ.mat` spelled out, when that is exactly Mathlib's `Matrix.IsSymm`. The name describes the expression rather than the standard term, and consumers lose the `IsSymm` API.

findings.evidence: ComplexSpinDensity.lean:173-174 `def IsParityInvariant : Prop := ∀ i j, ρ.mat i.rev j.rev = ρ.mat i j` vs Positivity.lean:227-228 `def IsParityInvariant (ρ : SpinDensity) : Prop := ρ.mat idxMM idxMM = ρ.mat idxPP idxPP ∧ ρ.mat idxMP idxMP = ρ.mat idxPM idxPM`; the PR's docstring at line 170-171 acknowledges the discrepancy.
findings.fix: Either strengthen the real `PDF.IsParityInvariant` to the same full-helicity-reversal condition (the compat policy permits changing it in-repo), or give the complex predicate a name that marks the difference, e.g. `IsFullyParityInvariant`, and keep `IsParityInvariant` for the diagonal content.
findings.issue: `SpinDensityC.IsParityInvariant` (∀ i j, full `Fin.rev` on both indices) and `PDF.IsParityInvariant` (two diagonal equalities, Positivity.lean:227-228) share a base name but are not the same condition: the complex one is strictly stronger and does not transport back and forth along `timeReversalInvariantEquiv`. A reader who sees `IsParityInvariant` on both sides of an equivalence the PR itself establishes will assume they correspond.

findings.evidence: `lemma IsParityInvariant.mat_idxMM_idxMM ... : ρ.mat idxMM idxMM = ρ.mat idxPP idxPP`; naming conventions: "Often the name of theorem simply describes the conclusion" — here the RHS is not a canonical normal form, so omitting it is not disambiguating.
findings.fix: Name after the full conclusion, e.g. `mat_idxMM_eq_mat_idxPP` and `mat_idxMP_eq_mat_idxPM`.
findings.issue: `IsParityInvariant.mat_idxMM_idxMM` (line 177) and `IsParityInvariant.mat_idxMP_idxMP` (line 182) name only the left-hand entry; the conclusion is an equality to a different entry, which the name does not record. The two names are near-identical in shape yet assert different facts.

summary: Names mostly follow the roadmap's binding conventions, but one lemma restates Mathlib's `Matrix.IsSymm` as a raw `ᵀ = ` equation, and `IsParityInvariant` names two inequivalent predicates on the two types the PR declares equivalent.
